To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of the two microalgae as a source of PUFA in pasta products is a viable alternative for the incorporation of these fatty acids in human diet.

1) the addition of 1.0 g/100g of Isochrysis galbanan biomass in pasta products, increases the PUFA content by 0.2 g/100 g, and the n-6 PUFA content by about 0.1 g/100 g and 0.2 mg/100 g of EPA and DHA, respectively; 2) the incorporation of 1 g/100g Diacronema vlikianum biomass in
the addition of 5% of Isochrysis galabana to pasta products, improves the fatty acid composition of the product and increases its antioxidant capacity, without altering its sensory properties.
